what: Stack: Dream-1 + LiveKit portal-makermods on the Creative track; skip Isaac Sim and RL
why: Judging is on real arms and Dream-1 needs no training. Portal's one-driver-at-a-time switch gives wait-and-hold almost for free, and moving from sim to real in 30 hours is a long shot.
details: First steps: Dream Labs API key and an arm station slot, then try Dream-1 untrained on "move the token to the next spot". Then the hand-in-workspace check and the voice agent. Still unconfirmed: Dream-1 API docs, Portal's fit with our MakerMods arm, and the Creative judging rubric.
